meta_rows: Nitrogen dioxide; land use regression land use regression (LUR) estimate for annual mean air pollution concentration (ug/m3) in 2009 - at age 60-64 years

Nitrogen dioxide (NO2) maps were modelled based on a land use regression (LUR) model. The NO2 map is based on input data from the Automatic Urban and Rural Network (AURN), Defra. For details of the models see references Gulliver et al, 2011 (for BS & SO2) and Gulliver et al, 2013 (for NO2).
